outcome: Method of last feed before hospital discharge
cohort: 599,191 singleton live births at ≥37 weeks' gestation in Victoria, Australia between 2010 and 2018
finding: Common intrapartum interventions are associated with less favorable breastfeeding outcomes, both in hospital and in the months after birth.
mod_finding: In-labor CS, pre-labor CS, epidural analgesia, and synthetic oxytocin infusion were all associated with less favorable breastfeeding outcomes.
